 I’ve been fortunate to grow up around police officers. My dad was a police officer, and my mom worked at the police department. Naturally, I developed a deep respect for law enforcement and a positive view of the men and women who choose this profession. When it came time to consider my own career, becoming a police officer was the one path that truly resonated with me.
 Twenty-two years into this career, I’ve come to realize that what initially attracted me to police work isn’t necessarily what motivates me today. Early in my career, my focus was more on identifying and apprehending suspects. Today, my perspective is broader. I’m equally focused on the victims whose lives are affected by crime, the strategies we use to respond to and investigate criminal activity, and the work we can do to prevent crime before it happens. I’m also deeply invested in the men and women of the Bakersfield Police Department and the positive impact they can have on our community.
